tool.name: Genion
tool.description: : Wrapper class for the GROMACS genion module.

param.name: input_tpr_path
param.label: input TPR file
param.help: Path to the input portable run input TPR file. Format: [input].tpr

param.name: input_top_zip_path
param.label: input ZIP file
param.help: Path the input TOP topology in zip format. Format: [input].zip

param.name: input_ndx_path
param.label: input NDX file
param.help: Path to the input index NDX file. Format: [input].ndx

param.name: outname_output_gro_path
param.label: output GRO name
param.help: Path to the input structure GRO file Format: [output].gro

param.name: outname_output_top_zip_path
param.label: output ZIP name
param.help: Path the output topology TOP and ITP files zipball Format: [output].zip

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: replaced_group
param.label: replaced_group
param.help: Group of molecules that will be replaced by the solvent.

param.name: neutral
param.label: neutral
param.help: Neutralize the charge of the system.

param.name: pname
param.label: pname
param.help: Name of the positive ion.

param.name: nname
param.label: nname
param.help: Name of the negative ion.

param.name: np
param.label: np
param.help: Number of positive ions to add.

param.name: nn
param.label: nn
param.help: Number of negative ions to add.

param.name: pq
param.label: pq
param.help: Charge of the positive ion.

param.name: nq
param.label: nq
param.help: Charge of the negative ion.

param.name: rmin
param.label: rmin
param.help: Minimum distance between ions and non-solvent in nm.

param.name: concentration
param.label: concentration
param.help: Concentration of the ions in (mol/liter). When nonzero, overrides np and nn. Neutralization adds ions on top of the specified counts or concentration.

param.name: seed
param.label: seed
param.help: Seed for random number generator.

param.name: gmx_lib
param.label: gmx_lib
param.help: Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the GROMACS executable binary.
